critical_code_review_comments: PointCard: The type badge is rendered inline next to the carrier name — good UX. Container uses truncate on the name; badge could get clipped for very long names but not observed with current data.
MapView: locker markers use square shape (border-radius:6px) vs circular for relais — visually distinguishable on map. clustering works chunked so 3193 markers load smoothly (~0.5s to count 3193).
MapApp.js: ptype dependency correctly added to fetchPoints useCallback — refetch fires on type change. Debounce=300ms is reasonable.

Backend server.py: GZipMiddleware(minimum_size=1000) is applied AFTER include_router — this is fine in Starlette (middleware wraps app). Confirmed working: Content-Encoding: gzip on /api/points response.
relay_data.py generate_points seeded with random.seed(42) so counts are deterministic (3193 = 2220+973).
Panel is still duplicated between desktop aside + mobile sheet → duplicate data-testids across DOM. Not a bug, but tests must scope to 'aside' (documented in previous iterations).
test_credentials: admin@relaispoint.fr / admin123 (verified). Fresh users registered via /api/auth/register for favorites tests.
